name: school_setup
summary: Campuses, terms/semesters, classrooms and the school calendar that the academic, attendance and examination modules build on
description: Institutional master data for a multi-campus school: school.campus (physical location with manager and contact details), school.term (configurable semesters/terms inside an academic year, with a current-term flag), school.classroom (rooms with type and capacity for the timetable to detect conflicts) and school.calendar.event (dated holidays, examination windows, sports days, parent-teacher meetings and term start/end, with a school-closed flag). Everything is company- and campus-scoped so one deployment can serve several sites without cross-contamination. This tranche is master/configuration data only; it mutates no fees, grades or attendance.
author: Nexa
